knowledge.json and COVERAGE.md in this directory are DERIVED WORKS of ConceptNet 5.7 and
WordNet 3.0 and carry the licences below. knowledge.json as a whole is distributed under
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . The extraction script
(experiments/extract_household_knowledge.py) is part of DREAM and is not covered by this file.

== ConceptNet attribution (required) ==
This data is built from ConceptNet 5.7 (https://conceptnet.io), by Robyn Speer, Joshua Chin and
Catherine Havasi, "ConceptNet 5.5: An Open Multilingual Graph of General Knowledge", AAAI 2017.
ConceptNet is released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Per ConceptNet's own terms, an edge's licence is
"cc:by-sa/4.0"; the dump also incorporates data from Open Mind Common Sense (MIT Media Lab),
Wiktionary (CC BY-SA), DBpedia (CC BY-SA), WordNet 3.1 (Princeton), Open Multilingual WordNet,
JMDict, OpenCyc and Verbosity-style games with a purpose; see https://github.com/commonsense/conceptnet5/wiki/Copyright-and-Licensing .
Changes made: only edges in the English /r/AtLocation, /r/LocatedNear and /r/Synonym relations
between a fixed list of household object and room names were selected; fields were reformatted
into JSON; WordNet lemmas were added and some synonyms were listed as rejected.
